journey.title: Joined FAST OFFER N5 and N4 Class
journey.description: This is my first time seriously studying Japanese. Sure, previously I have studied hiragana, katakana, and some of the general phrases in high school, but I have actually never touch the grammar, kanji, sentence pattern and other stuff. It was EXTRA challenging since I'm also doing my university tasks.

journey.title: Took JLPT N4
journey.description: After a year of studying Japanese (including the on-and-off season of burnout 草), I finally took the N4 exam. Thankfully it was first-try.

journey.title: Continuing FAST OFFER Class to N3
journey.description: After surviving the first year of class, I finally up my level to N3. This class was something. The spike of difficulty is quite there.

journey.title: Preparing for Job Interview
journey.description: Unexpectedly, my career advisor from the organization take a liking into my progress and started recommending interview class session for job interview that may come.

journey.title: Got my first job interview!!
journey.description: I can't believe I got my first Japanese company job interview at this early. The interview was honestly not as bad as I thought it would be. My explanation skill is not quite there yet, but I survive the grueling 2 rounds of interview. I didn't pass, though.

journey.title: My second job interview and actually passed (?!)
journey.description: I still can't believe I got this offer and being a 内定者. Truly, a dream come true.
